answer: Random peer audit: each epoch, five peers audit 10% of identities. Each checked identity shows five jobs and names partners; one with none stands out, and idle fakes sit frozen on a tundra. A fake flagged by three loses a 40 POA bond, while an honest agent climbs to the summit. 100 fakes lock 4,000 POA; half caught in six epochs lose 2,000. One honest identity risks one bond, keeps its full share and earns a violet badge after five clean audits.
